name: EMT first grounding revision: blinded comparison

variants.label: First gallery revision (known remaining grounding issue)

notes: Question files and references are unchanged; A/B labels were randomized independently per question and source/model labels hidden from paired reviewers.
Grades remain AI-assisted with human verification pending. These are previously seen development clips and annotated tracks, not held-out/trained-model results.
Changes include visual selection, general grounding instructions and provider-default sampling; differences do not establish one causal effect.
QA passes can be rescued by incidental full-scene pixels: independent identity audit still found wrong van1 highlighted for the pickup-motion question. Do not call that retrieval fixed.
The first revision retains an overconfident light-car colour and some control failures. All original and revised outputs are preserved.
The initial grade categories were rechecked while still blinded against the predeclared uncertainty/confidence definitions; raw initial judgments remain local.
No separate retrieval answer key is supplied; content passes are not ranking accuracy.
